entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: The Ghost Quarter of Ravnica, where ghosts of the dead linger.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: A rift giving access to Agyrem, accidentally created by Zomaj Hauc.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet magelord who created the Schism and betrayed Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Helped kill the hatchlings and apprehended Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A vampire parun who became a ghost and took over Agyrem.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros guildmaster and parun, killed battling Szadek.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Warship Razia flew through the Schism.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Broken pact whose laws remained in Agyrem.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event that dissolved the ghost-world anomaly.

events.summary: Zomaj Hauc accidentally creates the Schism while making a living space for ancient dragons.
events.quote: was accidentally created by Zomaj Hauc in 9965 Z.C.

events.summary: Hauc betrays Niv-Mizzet and the hatchlings are killed by Teysa Karlov, Agrus Kos and friends.
events.quote: the hatchlings were killed by Teysa Karlov , Agrus Kos , and their friends

events.summary: Razia flies the Parhelion through the Schism to fight Szadek; Razia is killed with countless Boros angels.
events.quote: Razia was killed, along with countless Boros angels

events.summary: Agrus Kos apprehends Szadek, who is banished into Agyrem, laid over Ravnica as the Schism is healed.
events.quote: the vampire was banished into Agyrem

events.summary: At the Mending the ghost-world anomaly dissolves and the trapped spirits pass on.
events.quote: the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

relations.quote: to do battle with Szadek and his spectral army in Agyrem
Razia , the Boros guildmaster and parun
Agyrem was the Ghost Quarter of Ravnica
